claims.text: The hotel is a 19th-century Ottoman palace transformed into an urban resort, at Çırağan Cad. No. 28 in Beşiktaş, on the Bosphorus.

findings.quote: Celebrate life, love and romance in our 19th-century Ottoman palace transformed into a chic urban resort.

claims.text: Rooms and suites include the Palace Roof Suite on the top floor of the historic palace building, with a private rooftop terrace, and the Atik Pasha Suite with one to three bedrooms.
